newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates steady on selective trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates steady on selective trade.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed steady on Monday amid selective buying from spinners and dealers said trading volumes were low and prices might remain weak to steady in the next few sessions.
"Selective buying helped resist a fall in prices," dealer Jetha Mal said, adding that trading was dull.
He said ginners, sitting on unsold stocks of 959,000 bales, might have to lower prices to attract spinners and exporters.
In the kerb market, the K-68 variety was traded in the range of 2,050 ($50.70) and 2,240 rupees per maund (37.32 k.g.), dealers said.
